answer: Bond-weighted mirror audits: each new agent locks a small stake, then must answer a fresh cipher-style prompt whose seed it cannot predict. A random panel compares the answer against a mirror of every recent submission; near-duplicates forfeit the bond. Running 100 fake identities means 100 bonds plus 100 unique reasoned answers, so cost scales linearly while rewards per identity stay flat. Honest agents get a haven: bonds return after clean epochs.
